notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
description:
During an opponent turn, activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U/R}{U/R}{U}{U}.
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control and putting Reset into your hand as it resolves due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Repeat.
